participation.context: Kept last week's thirty as last week's, and refused to marry it to twenty-four lines.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the new moon, took threepence, and would not start Lent at breakfast.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Named the finger short, and asked which kind of number thirty was.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: she will not turn a fast into Saturday's pot
relations.quote: I am not salting the week ahead of the church.

story.body: You paid threepence and left the fast on Wednesday. You did not turn twenty-four lines into money. You did not open the coffer for a number to take out.

relations.note: she will not turn a fast into Saturday's pot

participation.context: Wrote the unpaid sums and wrote no balance.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set down last week's thirty and wrote no figure for this week. You did not open a total, and you did not invent one.

title: Set down last week's thirty shillings
